name: Angel Holy Trinity
overview: The Scriptures reveal the Angel Holy Trinity as a divine figure uniquely identified by titles such as the Angel of God, the Angel of the LORD, and the Angel of His Presence, demonstrating a special role within God's redemptive work. This Angel appears in critical moments, such as guiding Hagar (Genesis 16:7,9), calling to Abraham (Genesis 22:11), manifesting in the burning bush (Exodus 3:2), leading Israel (Exodus 14:19), and confronting Balaam (Numbers 22:23). These appearances emphasize the Angel's authoritative presence and intimate association with God, underscoring the belief that this Angel is one of the persons of the Holy Trinity acting directly on God's behalf.
